title: Minecraft Redstone Engineering
description: A compact architecture fixture for version-sensitive practical knowledge demonstrated through functioning builds and debugging.

nodes.summary: Predict how power reaches dust and common components while stating the game edition and version assumptions.

nodes.title: Control signal timing
nodes.summary: Use repeaters and pulse behavior to delay, extend, shorten, and synchronize representative signals.

nodes.title: Build and explain Redstone logic circuits
nodes.summary: Construct basic logical operations and explain the relationship between inputs, outputs, and component behavior.

nodes.title: Debug a version-scoped Redstone build
nodes.summary: Trace a failed build, isolate the first incorrect state, test a hypothesis, and repair it without replacing the whole design.

nodes.title: Minecraft Wiki Redstone circuits
nodes.summary: A community-maintained reference candidate for components, circuits, and edition-specific behavior.

nodes.title: Measure a version-scoped power line
nodes.summary: Build a labeled test line, predict power states and signal strengths, then compare predictions with observed behavior in one declared edition and version.

nodes.title: Measure and reshape Redstone pulses
nodes.summary: Use repeaters and a visible output to measure delays, extend a pulse, shorten a pulse, and synchronize two paths.

nodes.title: Build, label, and perturb a logic circuit
nodes.summary: Construct a circuit, label its states, deliberately introduce one fault, and trace the resulting behavior.

nodes.title: Redstone power diagnostic
nodes.summary: A short offline diagnostic for baseline power behavior under declared Java Edition assumptions.

mastery.instructions: Answer both Java Edition power scenarios without opening the game or reference material.

questions.prompt: In Java Edition, a dust line begins at signal strength 15. What strength does the next dust block along the line carry?
A repeater receives a nonzero rear input. What signal strength does it emit from its front?

options.label: Always the same strength as its input.
Full strength 15 after its configured delay.
A strength selected by the game tick.

nodes.title: Pulse timing demonstration
nodes.summary: A version-labeled build demonstrating measured delays and pulse transformations.

mastery.instructions: Submit one version-labeled test rig that demonstrates a measured delay, a pulse extension or shortening, and two synchronized paths. Explain the measured timings.

nodes.title: Logic circuit demonstration
nodes.summary: A functioning circuit with a truth table and explanation of each state.

mastery.instructions: Build a version-labeled circuit implementing at least two logical operations, demonstrate every input state, and explain how components produce the truth table.

nodes.title: Redstone debugging record
nodes.summary: Evidence from a functioning build and a traceable repair process.

mastery.instructions: Submit a working version-scoped circuit plus a concise trace of one deliberately introduced failure: observed state, first incorrect component, hypothesis, test, and repair.

edges.rationale: Timing control depends on predicting ordinary power and component behavior.
Practical logic circuits depend on stable signal timing as well as logical state.
Debugging requires a correct behavioral model of the circuit being traced.
The wiki documents component and edition-specific behavior.
The free wiki documents repeater delays, pulses, and edition-specific timing behavior.
The free wiki documents representative logic circuit designs and component behavior.
The version-scoped reference helps distinguish design faults from edition-specific behavior.
Prediction and measurement make power behavior observable under explicit version assumptions.
The measured rig practices delay, pulse transformation, and synchronization.
Construction and state labeling connect logical descriptions to game behavior.
Deliberate perturbation produces a bounded debugging experience.
Both deterministic scenarios must be solved correctly under the declared edition assumptions.
The measured build demonstrates practical control of Redstone timing.
The functioning build and truth table demonstrate circuit logic rather than copied construction.
The artifact demonstrates both a functioning repair and the reasoning that produced it.
